title: One at a time
name: Reminex Gameplay
lede: A ~20-minute video every day at 12:00 UTC. Colombia's Gaming chart never held two of them at once — and two of its strongest never got in.

src: Views per day = views today ÷ days since publication, read on 7 Oct at 23:50 UTC; newer videos look higher because views come early. Usual = 52K (median of the channel's long-form videos 7–90 days before its latest record). Chart presence from our daily reading, one a day (a video can enter and leave between two readings). v1…v10 = the channel's uploads in order. Last fact: every channel × country × category × day in our snapshots, 30 Sep–6 Oct, all categories except Music, videos listed in a single category (2,382 cases with multi-category videos cannot be placed in one chart from our storage).
